title: Rehearsal checklist: the claims of 'The canonical massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional O(3) model' (openai/math family 215)
purpose: A rehearsal of the Yang-Mills pre-registration on public material. The obligations are the paper's own claims (Theorem 1.1, Theorem 1.2, Corollary 1.3), written in the same schema as the Yang-Mills checklist, so the same tools can map what the Lean formalization covers.
scope: Formal statement fidelity only. Nothing here assesses whether the paper's proof is correct, its credit or its announcement.
anchoring_rule: The obligations quote the paper, pinned by SHA-256. The Lean statement is mapped onto them, never the reverse.

claims.O3: Theorem 1.1, Theorem 1.2 and Corollary 1.3: a canonical continuum limit of the nearest-neighbour two-dimensional O(3) model through all real beta -> infinity, satisfying the OS axioms, internally O(3) invariant, with a nonzero connected four-point function, a unique vacuum and a positive mass gap.
claims.DECAY: Companion paper: exponential decay of two-point correlations for the classical nearest-neighbour O(n) model, n >= 3, at every finite positive inverse temperature, uniformly over finite free-boundary subgraphs.

O3paper.citation: OpenAI, The canonical massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional O(3) model (October 4, 2026), openai/math preprint.

DecayPaper.citation: OpenAI, Exponential decay in two-dimensional classical O(n) models (September 23, 2026), openai/math preprint. Abstract read in CONTENTS.md, family 215.

OS73.citation: K. Osterwalder and R. Schrader, Axioms for Euclidean Green's functions, Commun. Math. Phys. 31 (1973), 83-112.

volume.meaning: infinite = the plane (or Z^2); torus = periodic box; finite_box = finite subgraph.

spacing.meaning: Lattice spacing of the object; 0 for a continuum object.

continuum_limit.meaning: canonical = through all real beta -> infinity without subsequences (or a direct continuum construction); prescribed_trajectory = along one chosen sequence beta_N; subsequence_only = a limit point; none = no limit.

field.meaning: Which model's fields the object carries.

os_regularity.meaning: Tempered Schwinger functions with the factorial bound.

os_euclidean_invariance.meaning: Invariance under the full Euclidean group E(2).

internal_o3_invariance.meaning: Invariance under the internal O(3) rotations of the spins.

connected_4pt.meaning: Whether a connected four-point correlation is nonzero (non-Gaussian).

unique_vacuum.meaning: The reconstructed theory has a unique vacuum and a nonzero vacuum complement.

mass_gap.meaning: Lower bound of the continuum Hamiltonian on the vacuum complement.

two_point_decay.meaning: Decay of the two-point correlation in the object's own units.

obligations.title: The nearest-neighbour O(3) model
obligations.requirement: The fields are those of the nearest-neighbour O(3) model with unit spins, no external field and no topological term.

obligations.title: Two dimensions
obligations.requirement: The theory is two-dimensional (1 + 1 after reconstruction).

obligations.title: Infinite volume
obligations.requirement: The object lives on the whole plane: the periodic thermodynamic limit, then the continuum limit.

sources.locator: Theorem 1.1: the periodic thermodynamic limit exists; Theorem 1.2 (i): tori tending to the plane

obligations.title: Canonical continuum limit
obligations.requirement: The fields (1.3) converge as beta -> infinity through all real values, without subsequences, to one limiting hierarchy.

obligations.title: OS axiom: regularity
obligations.requirement: Schwinger distributions in S'((R^2)^n) with the factorial bound of Theorem 1.2 (ii).

obligations.title: OS axiom: Euclidean invariance
obligations.requirement: Invariance under the full Euclidean group of the plane.

obligations.title: OS axiom: reflection positivity
obligations.requirement: Reflection positivity of the limiting Schwinger distributions.

obligations.title: OS axiom: symmetry
obligations.requirement: Permutation symmetry of the Schwinger distributions.

obligations.title: OS axiom: cluster property
obligations.requirement: Clustering of the limiting Schwinger distributions.

obligations.title: Internal O(3) invariance
obligations.requirement: The limiting hierarchy is internally O(3) invariant.

obligations.title: Nonzero connected four-point function
obligations.requirement: A connected four-point distribution is nonzero on smooth tests with strictly separated time supports (no Wick factorization).

obligations.title: Unique vacuum, nonzero vacuum complement
obligations.requirement: The reconstructed theory has a unique vacuum and a nonzero vacuum complement.

obligations.title: Positive Hamiltonian gap
obligations.requirement: H_phys restricted to the vacuum complement is at least m > 0 (in the continuum theory's units).

obligations.title: Exponential decay of lattice two-point correlations
obligations.requirement: For n >= 3 and every beta > 0, two-point correlations decay exponentially, uniformly over finite free-boundary subgraphs and bounded nonnegative edge strengths.

witnesses.title: Zero theory on R^2
witnesses.note: All Schwinger functions vanish beyond order 0. Any upper bound on the two-point function holds. The vacuum complement is empty, which the paper's 'nonzero vacuum complement' excludes. The field label is left free.

witnesses.title: Free massive three-component Gaussian field on R^2
witnesses.note: Satisfies every OS axiom, has a unique vacuum, a mass gap and O(3) symmetry. Only the nonzero connected four-point function (and the field identity) separates it from the claim.

witnesses.title: Lattice O(3) model on a finite subgraph of Z^2 at small beta
witnesses.note: Exponential decay at high temperature (small beta) is classical, from high-temperature expansions; it needs none of the family's results. This witness carries the lattice model's field label, two dimensions and exponential decay, and nothing continuum.

witnesses.title: Lattice O(3) model on a periodic torus
witnesses.note: A finite periodic box at fixed spacing.

witnesses.title: Three-dimensional lattice O(3) model
witnesses.note: The same model in another dimension; it has a low-temperature ordered phase, so it does not decay exponentially at every beta. Its decay is left free.

witnesses.title: Continuum limit point along a prescribed trajectory or subsequence
witnesses.note: What Theorem 1.2 gives before Theorem 1.1 removes the trajectory. Other features left free.
